capabilities: Build a content tree by traversing links from an index note
Merge linked notes into a single Markdown file with nesting via keyword links
Generate slideshow templates for the Advanced Slides plugin
Translate Markdown into XeLaTeX with optional custom templates
Create citations from a literature note in book or web formats
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also translates Markdown into XeLaTeX and generates slideshow templates, not just merged Markdown.
extras: Documentation is partly incomplete (a settings section is empty and the LaTeX section is marked TBA); the LaTeX template feature targets the PEF Mendelu university template.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine a set of linked notes into one unified document based on their link structure.

relations.evidence: Generate slideshow template that is compatible with obsidian advanced slides plugin

summary: Merges notes linked from an index note into a single Markdown file, with optional XeLaTeX conversion and Advanced Slides template generation.
